soldier: Soldier: head yellowish brown, thorax and abdomen pale yellow. The lateral margins of the fontanelle with two pairs of hairs, the disc of the pronotum with about ten hairs. Head pear-shaped, the fontanelle aperture roundly arched, the aperture vertical in profile, rising gradually from the top of the aperture to the dorsal margin of the head, the top of the head rather flat; antennae with 14 segments (the specimen is broken); labrum spear-shaped, the apical and subapical hairs both rather long; mandibles slender and curved, the outer margin slightly constricted near the base, the left mandible about 69–70 per cent of the length of the head capsule; postmentum rather long, its surface rather flat, the waist region at about the posterior third. The concavities of the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum are both rather distinct. Length of the hind tibia 1.10–1.15 mm.
